readme: Whether this build of the app can sell anything through the App Store or Google Play.
false: the app shows no purchase, upgrade, top-up or restore control, never opens a
store connection, and the Android manifest drops the Play Billing permission. The
store listings then declare no in-app purchases.
true: the purchase screens and the store connection are compiled in, and both store
listings must declare in-app purchases with the products attached for review.
scripts/lib/rollout/store-listing.mjs all read this one value, so the binary, the
screens and the listing declarations cannot disagree. Changing it needs a new store
build and a new review; it is never switched by an over-the-air update or the server.
Selling also needs the server side described in docs/runbooks/mobile-store-products.md.
